name: Alexandra Tresman
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: I am a Senior Counsellor and Psychotherapist with a background across clinical, educational, and private settings, supporting children from the age of 5, young people, and adults experiencing a wide range of mental health issues and life stresses. I am highly experienced in providing behavioural support and working with neurodiversity, adapting interventions to meet individual emotional, behavioural, and developmental needs. I specialise in integrative, evidence-based practice, drawing on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Psychodynamic Therapy, Solution-Focused Therapy, Mindfulness, and Play Therapy to deliver effective and responsive therapeutic support.

name: Angeliki Koukoura
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a warm, person-centred counsellor committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and LGBTQIA+ affirming space where you can feel heard, understood, and accepted without judgement. My approach is inspired by somatic and narrative therapies, alongside person-centred and queer-affirming practice. I work with clients navigating a range of experiences, including anxiety, depression, identity exploration, life transitions, relationship difficulties, and the impacts of difficult or traumatic experiences.
